description: This file defines a wizard for creating membership invoices in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including a function to generate invoices based on selected products and partners, and a wizard interface with a form for selecting a membership product.

classes.name: wizard_invoice_membership
classes.description: A wizard interface for creating membership invoices with states for form input and confirmation.

methods.name: _invoice_membership
methods.description: Generates invoices for selected partners with a specified product, handling address and tax details.
